# bioexcel/biobb_cp2k/cp2k_run

## Summary

Wrapper of the CP2K QM tool module.

Runs atomistic simulations of solid state, liquid, molecular, periodic, material, crystal, and biological systems using CP2K QM tool.

Nextflow adapter of the [Cp2kRun](https://biobb-cp2k.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cp2k.html#module-cp2k.cp2k_run) building block of [biobb_cp2k](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_cp2k) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CP2K_CP2K_RUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_cp2k/cp2k_run'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CP2K_CP2K_RUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_inp_path` | yes | inp, in, txt, wfn | Input configuration file (CP2K run options) |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_log_path` | yes | log, out, txt, o | Output log file |
| `output_outzip_path` | yes | zip, gzip, gz | Output files |
| `output_rst_path` | yes | wfn | Output restart file |
| `versions_biobb_cp2k` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_cp2k', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Cp2kRun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_log_path: 'log']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_cp2k container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CP2K_CP2K_RUN' {
        ext.properties = [binary_path: 'cp2k.sopt']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `binary_path` | string | "cp2k.sopt" | CP2K binary path to be used. |
| `param_path` | string | null | Path to the CP2K parameter data files (BASIS_SET, POTENTIALS, etc.). If not provided, the parameter data files included in the package will be used. |
| `mpi_bin` | string | null | Path to the MPI runner. Usually "mpirun" or "srun". |
| `mpi_np` | integer | 0 | Number of MPI processes. Usually an integer bigger than 1. |
| `mpi_flags` | string | null | Path to the MPI hostlist file. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
